view: Frontal (PA) chest radiograph, erect; "L" side marker at the image upper-right corner (patient's left) confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate inspiration (about 8-9 posterior ribs visible), penetration acceptable with the lower thoracic spine faintly seen through the mediastinum, minimal rotation. Both scapulae are incompletely rotated and project over the lateral upper/mid lung fields. Apices and costophrenic angles are included; upper abdomen partly included.

devices.type: L side marker (external film label, not a medical device)
devices.location: image upper-right corner, patient's left shoulder region

abnormalities.finding: Homogeneous dense opacity occupying the left lower zone with a smooth upward-convex superior contour and a laterally up-turned meniscus, consistent with a moderate left pleural effusion

Left hemidiaphragm not separately visualised; the apparent 'dome' sits high with a markedly increased distance to the gastric/colonic gas below, suggesting a subpulmonic component of the effusion (pseudo-elevation of the left hemidiaphragm)
Left heart border partially obscured by the basal opacity (silhouette sign); cardiothoracic ratio cannot be reliably measured, cardiac silhouette appears at least borderline enlarged
Upper mediastinum appears mildly broad with a prominent aortic knob, likely projectional/ectatic aorta; trachea midline
Mildly accentuated bronchovascular markings at the right lung base, no focal consolidation

description_zh: 正面站立胸部X光，吸氣尚可，兩側肩胛骨部分重疊於外側肺野，未見任何管路、引流管或植入裝置。左下肺野可見均質性緻密影，上緣呈平滑向上凸之弧形、外側呈向上之半月徵，左側橫膈及左側肋膈角被遮蔽，且與下方胃泡／結腸氣體間距明顯增大，符合左側中等量肋膜積液，並疑合併肺下型積液。心臟左緣部分被遮蔽（輪廓徵），心胸比無法準確評估，上縱膈稍寬、主動脈結突出，氣管居中。右肺大致清晰，右下肺紋理稍增加，右側肋膈角銳利；骨骼及軟組織無明顯異常。
